verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents self-hosting the engine as a dependency-free single binary on Linux, macOS, or Windows, with official Docker images and Helm charts. Community users confirm running it on Kubernetes, Docker, and Hetzner boxes at scale. Parity with the hosted product is not established: the evidence ties read high availability and clusterization to the Cloud offering, and community reports say the replicated/distributed version is not freely available. Missing for 10: documented feature parity between self-hosted and Cloud, a self-hosted HA/replication/clustering path, and confirmation that Cloud-marketed features (e.g. analytics, personalization, dynamic search rules) run self-hosted.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the full engine — same features as the hosted product — on my own infrastructure

citations.quote: Meilisearch is a single binary with no external dependencies. You can run it on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine, on bare metal or in containers.
Install Meilisearch locally on Linux, macOS, or Windows using cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT, or from source.
Helm charts for deploying Meilisearch on Kubernetes.
Official Meilisearch Docker images for easy deployment and development.
For production deployments, you will also need: A reverse proxy (Nginx or Caddy) for HTTPS termination A process manager (systemd)... A master key for authentication
